effective_or_revised: Header on each page: 'Effective 09/01/2026' (library metadata: 09/01/2024; text says InterQual use 'on or after September 1, 2024'); Medicare Coverage Database searched 07/20/2026
criteria_location: There are no clinical criteria in this document. Criteria are delegated: InterQual CP:Procedures subsets for MassHealth ACO and Community Care members 18+; CMS NCD 20.4 for Medicare products. The only written rules are exclusions and the EV-ICD coverage statement (pp. 1-3).

logic.top_level: other (routing document: by line of business to InterQual, NCD, or exclusion)
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Two exclusion bullets: 'Any use of implantable cardioverter defibrillators other than outlined above.' and EV-ICD (0571T-0580T, 0614T) 'experimental/investigational and not medically necessary for MassHealth ACO and Community Care members'.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Replacement criteria live in InterQual (subset 'Pulse Generator Replacement'); nothing in the document.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Effective for dates of service on or after September 1, 2024, Fallon Health will use InterQual criteria when making medical necessity determinations for implantable cardioverter defibrillators for MassHealth ACO and Community Care members 18 years of age and older.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: What applies to MassHealth/Community Care members under 18 is not stated; and what applies before 9/1/2024 is not stated.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Fallon Health Clinical Coverage Criteria apply to MassHealth ACO and Community Care members.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: The heading calls the InterQual references 'Fallon Health Clinical Coverage Criteria' though the criteria are not Fallon's own text.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: MassHealth does not have Guidelines for Medical Necessity Determination for implantable cardioverter defibrillators ..., therefore, the Plan's coverage criteria are applicable.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Circular for a checker: 'the Plan's coverage criteria' are InterQual, which is not reproduced.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Any use of implantable cardioverter defibrillators other than outlined above.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'Outlined above' covers only references to InterQual and the NCD, not clinical criteria.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Note: When a dual-chamber ICD insertion is planned, criteria must also be met for the insertion of an atrial pacing lead.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Cross-criteria requirement: criteria for a second device/lead from a different InterQual subset must also be met.

extraction_hazards: Almost no criteria text: a keyword extractor would return an empty tree and may pick up the EV-ICD trial evidence (Summary of Evidence, ~3 pages of study results with percentages that look like thresholds, e.g., '88%', '79%', '98.7%').
Effective date mismatch: page headers say 'Effective 09/01/2026' while the text says 'on or after September 1, 2024' and library metadata says 09/01/2024.
Code table has a prior-authorization column with future-dated entries ('No effective 9/1/2026', 'Yes effective 12/1/2026'); the table splits across pages with hanging descriptions.
Checkbox glyphs for products (☒) in the Policy section carry the plan list.
Different rules by product in prose paragraphs ('Medicare Variation', 'MassHealth Variation'), not in structured form.
InterQual criteria are referenced by name and are proprietary; the actual criteria cannot be extracted from this PDF.
interesting_structures: Pure delegation: criteria are a pointer to InterQual subsets (by product line and age), with the plan's own text limited to exclusions.
Product routing table in prose: MassHealth ACO/Community Care (18+) get InterQual, Medicare products get NCD 20.4.
Per-code prior authorization requirement column, including future-dated changes.
EV-ICD covered for Medicare under the NCD but investigational for MassHealth, in the same document.
Two-device rule: dual-chamber ICD plus atrial pacing lead needs two criteria sets.

fit_to_tree.scale: 1 = clean, 5 = needs new constructs or human judgment
fit_to_tree.why: No clinical criteria exist in the document; a tree built from it would be empty or would have to follow citations to InterQual (proprietary) and NCD 20.4 (which this payer's Medicare variation incorporates). The checker needs a 'delegated' node type and the target text.
